summary: Tower Semiconductor Ltd filed Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, reporting the completion of its annual rating review by S&P Maalot. The corporate credit rating was reaffirmed at ilAA, and the outlook was revised from Stable to Positive. The filing includes no transaction, no M&A, no capital return, and no board or management change. It is a routine disclosure of a rating action by a foreign private issuer. No special situation event or deal structure exists. Investors should monitor any subsequent rating changes or corporate developments.
